title: Career Roadmap: Meteorologist (IMD after PG)
summary: Career Domain: Environment, Energy & Sustainability · Qualification Pathway: B.Sc – Meteorology / Atmospheric Science · Target Career: Meteorologist (IMD after PG)

about.label: About this roadmap
about.text: This roadmap was drafted with AI assistance from OneGrasp's related roadmaps and is awaiting expert review. Check fees, dates, eligibility and exam patterns on the official websites before you rely on them.

blocks.text: A Meteorologist studies the atmosphere to forecast weather and understand climate, from daily forecasts to cyclone warnings. Scientist posts at the India Meteorological Department (IMD) need a postgraduate degree; a B.Sc in Meteorology / Atmospheric Science is the base.
What a Meteorologist (IMD after PG) does

items.text: Analyse observations from stations, radars and satellites
Run and interpret numerical weather prediction models
Issue forecasts and warnings for public, aviation, farming and shipping
Study climate trends and extreme weather
IITM Pune, NCMRWF and other research institutes
Airports, ports and the armed forces' weather services

rows.text: Scientist E-F / Head of a forecasting centre

blocks.text: Year 1: Physics and maths for the atmosphere

items.text: Follow IMD's daily weather and cyclone bulletins
Learn to read weather maps, satellite and radar images
Work with real station data in Python

blocks.text: Year 3: Forecasting and prepare for the PG

items.text: Project on monsoon, rainfall or a past cyclone using real data
Try running a simple weather model (WRF) with guidance
Apply for M.Sc / M.Tech in Meteorology or Atmospheric Science

blocks.label: Note
blocks.text: IMD Scientist posts need a PG; the SSC Scientific Assistant (IMD) exam is an entry route with a B.Sc in Physics/related subjects.

items.text: WMO and NPTEL courses in meteorology

blocks.label: Before you enrol
blocks.text: Check the current syllabus, fees and eligibility on the certifying body's official website.
Entrance exams and tests to know:

items.text: CSIR-NET (Earth, Atmospheric, Ocean and Planetary Sciences)
MS in Atmospheric Science (US, UK, Germany)

blocks.text: Roles a Meteorologist (IMD after PG) can grow into or move across to:

items: Scientist E-F / Head of a forecasting centre
